title: Assistant
scripted: This assistant is scripted. It picks its answers from a short script, and nothing else about it is pretend: it reads the actions the workbench offers it, speaks real protocol events, and every call runs through the workbench itself. No model, no key, no network.
empty: Nothing yet. Pick a prompt below and watch what it may do.
offered: Reading what it may do right now: {{count}} actions.
notOffered: {{command}} is not among them. It asks anyway, so you can see who says no.

confirm.title: Send this quote?
confirm.message: The assistant wants to send the quote to the customer, and the customer will see it. Say no, and watch what the assistant is told.

result.answered: The workbench ran it and answered: {{content}}
result.refused: The workbench did not run it.

openQuote.prompt: Open the quote for Nordwind Logistik.
openQuote.says: Nordwind Logistik is on quote Q-0007. Opening it now.
openQuote.closes: It is open in the content area, and it stays as a tab.
openQuote.refused: I was not allowed to open it, so nothing happened.

overview.closes: The dashboard has the whole content area now. It is not a document, so it took no tab, and nothing reloaded.
overview.refused: I was not allowed to show it, so you are still where you were.

sendQuote.prompt: Send quote Q-0004 to the customer.
sendQuote.says: Q-0004 is still a draft. Sending it to the customer.
sendQuote.closes: It has gone out, and the quote is marked as sent.
sendQuote.refused: You said no, so it never ran. The workbench was not even asked.

margin.prompt: What is the margin on Q-0007?
margin.closes: There it is: revenue, cost and what is left. Only accounting may see this, and that is the account you are on.
margin.refused: Margins are for accounting, and the account you are signed in as is not. Switch accounts and ask me again.

look.prompt: Give the product a different look.
look.warns: This one reloads the page, and the conversation ends with it. A look here is composed at startup: the colours, the letterforms, the icons and part of the wording are decided once, when the application boots. That is what makes it a composition rather than a colour switch.
look.says: Switching the product to {{look}}. Watch the whole thing change.
look.closes: The look is on its way.
look.refused: I was not allowed to change the look.
